title: Fault family — ProofRequirementKind.Dimension: a period operand must have the required time dimension (Date for date arithmetic, Time for time arithmetic)

provenance.compilerHoleCheck: Every witness in this file was checked against the known compiler holes named in the corrected-inputs (BUG-033 into-binding, the write-surface enumeration gap). NONE of these Dimension witnesses depend on a guard fact surviving across a write site: the dimension of a period is a static type attribute of the operand, established by the field/arg declaration or a narrowing guard read at the same site, with no cross-write transport. So no cell in this file rests on BUG-033 or the write-surface gap. The one build gap this family DOES hit is orthogonal to those holes and is recorded per cell and in openFlags: an event ARG declared `of 'date'` is not consulted by the discharge (ResolvePeriodDimension handles TypedFieldRef only), so premise (b) is inert for Dimension today.

dischargeMechanism.procedure: dimension = ResolvePeriodDimension(subject) ?? NarrowedPeriodDimensionFromGuard(subject); discharge iff dimension is Any or dimension == RequiredDimension. ResolvePeriodDimension (Strategies.cs:295-309) reads the subject field's DeclaredQualifiers (TemporalDimension.Value or TemporalUnit.DerivedDimension) — TypedFieldRef only. NarrowedPeriodDimensionFromGuard (ProofEngine.QualifierNarrowing.cs:182-194) reads a `when X.dimension == 'date'|'time'` narrowing on the TemporalDimension axis for an open period.
dischargeMechanism.diagnostic: PRE0113 UnprovedDimensionRequirement (src/Precept/Language/DiagnosticCode.cs:249; ProofRequirementMeta.Dimension.DiagnosticCode; formatted at ProofEngine.Diagnostics.cs:50-54). Live message: "'<field>' must declare `of 'date'` before it can be used here". Both the base and every near-miss reject naming THIS obligation (Dimension / PRE0113).

notes: The Dimension obligation is decidable exactly from the operand's declared temporal dimension (a static type attribute), so there is no value-arithmetic sound-but-unprovable band of the kind the Numeric family carries. A sound program (the operand genuinely IS date/time-dimensioned) is always respellable into a licensed form: declare the field's dimension (`period of 'date'`/`of 'time'`) — premise (a) — or narrow an open period with a guard (`when X.dimension == 'date'`) — premise (c). Both respellings were live-verified accepting at HEAD.

Distinct from the band: the premise-(b) build gap (an event arg declared `of 'date'` is not consulted) is a BUILT-vs-MODEL gap, not a sound-but-unprovable band member — the model licenses arg-declared dimension, the shipped strategy does not read it. Recorded per cell and in openFlags; it does not change the respellability verdict (the author can respell by moving the operand to a declared field, or the gap is closed by build work).

cells.premiseAvailability: Premise (a) — field modifier: available when the period operand is a FIELD declared `... as period of 'date'` (or `of 'time'`). ResolvePeriodDimension reads the field's declared TemporalDimension/TemporalUnit qualifier. LIVE-VERIFIED accept. Premise (c) — handler guard: available for an OPEN period when the transition ROW carries `when ⟨period⟩.dimension == 'date'`; NarrowedPeriodDimensionFromGuard reads it. LIVE-VERIFIED accept. Premise (b) — arg modifier: NOT available today (BUILD GAP): an event arg declared `of 'date'` is ignored — ResolvePeriodDimension handles TypedFieldRef only, not TypedArgRef. LIVE-VERIFIED reject (see openFlags). Premise (d) — pre-state constraint: no validity argument exists in the matrix § Rule validity for a (d)-based discharge of a fault obligation, and no establishment/preservation machinery exists; recorded as a missing rule, not resolved here (same disposition the Numeric fault cells record).

openFlags: Premise (b) build gap: an event ARG declared `of 'date'` does not discharge (arg operand `Shift.Term as period of 'date'` still rejects PRE0113 — verified DimArgB). Under the model an arg's declared dimension is a static type fact that should discharge; ResolvePeriodDimension ignores TypedArgRef. Build gap, not a definition gap. When the operand at this occasion is an arg, only a field-hosted respelling discharges today.

Citation duty (2026-07-21) vs. a type-structural modifier: the citation duty requires a proof consuming a field modifier to name the establishing obligation and every preserving obligation. A temporal-dimension qualifier is a type attribute, immutable across writes (a write of a wrong-dimension period is a type error / AssignmentQualifier PRE0141, not a preservation obligation), so there is NO minted establishing/preserving obligation to name. What the citation duty resolves to for a type-structural fact is undefined by the matrix's generative sections. Routed to owner.
